data.description: 【菈菈 · 戴比路克星际圣殿的王女威仪】统领浩瀚银河的戴比路克王星皇宫圣殿内，宏伟的悬浮水晶柱与全息星图环绕。菈菈身着戴比路克王族露肩科幻战服，端坐在悬浮的黄金王座之上。及踝的粉色长发铺陈在晶莹的水晶台阶上，褪去了日常的迷糊，绿瞳带着帝王长女特有的从容与威严，爱心尾巴在王座扶手边优雅蜷曲，尽显银河至高王女的绝世尊荣。

data.promptProse: Lala sits composed on Deviluke's floating golden throne, one hand supporting her chin, wearing her white-and-yellow royal battle dress. Pink hair spreads down the crystal steps and her heart-tipped tail curls beside the armrest. The low three-quarter full-body view places suspended columns and holographic charts around the throne. Cool nebula light enters the crystal dome, separating her silhouette while gold surfaces return warmer reflections onto her sleeves.
